Select exact IC50 measurements in nM for compounds tested against human prostaglandin E synthase (CHEMBL5658). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary, filtering by target_chembl_id CHEMBL5658 and standard_type IC50 with standard_units nM. Include exact values only (standard_relation = '='). Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical_smiles. Join docs via activities.doc_id to obtain pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi). Join compound_records via activities.record_id to retrieve compound_key. Return columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
